name: Misty Pine Refuge
summary: At Misty Pine Refuge, the Argent Dawn keeps a small outpost in central Dun Morogh.

sections.title: Shelter in the Snow
sections.body: Misty Pine Refuge is an unassuming Argent Dawn outpost among Dun Morogh's windswept hills. Ironforge mountaineers patrol the surrounding crags, while Father Gavin, the order's lone agent here, keeps a quiet hearth amid the bitter cold and dangers of the mountain roads.

faq.answer: Misty Pine Refuge is a small Argent Dawn outpost in central Dun Morogh, kept by the order's single agent there, Father Gavin.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn here in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: Though the Argent Dawn focuses chiefly on the undead menace in the north, agents such as Father Gavin keep watch in quieter corners of Alliance lands.
Father Gavin, an Argent Dawn agent, is the order's only member stationed at the refuge.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see Father Gavin's humble post as an example of the Light's service through quiet vigilance, far from the battlefields.
